ashley: quick sync - customer pilots require a clear SLA + contract language for audit exports and BYOK. can we lock down core launch criteria this week?

devon: core gates i propose:
- append-only streams confirmed (immutable)
- signed ndjson manifests for each export
- export SLA: max latency 4h for full export, streaming ok
- per-tenant concurrency caps + burst policy

ravi: keys: support customer-wrapped KEKs. design soft-handshake: wrap DEKs, store wrapped DEKs, escrow only on multi-approval. need audit trail.

marta: SOC2: each gate maps to control id and evidence artifact. need daily retention proof (signed manifest) for auditors and per-region retention matrix.

sophia: legal: draft contract blurb: customer responsible for KEK rotation; Redwood provides emergency escrow with documented approvals and notifications. Also need legal-hold freeze process.

ashley: action items: @devon manifest schema + smoke tests, @ravi key-handshake + escrow audit steps, @marta control mapping + retention matrix, @sophia contract language. review Fri 9am.

devon: will push a short PR Wed.

ashley: thanks. keep the thread for blockers only. :rocket:
